title: Story premise EDU015: The Glass With an Outside Leak
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (everyday science). Hook: How can a sealed glass leak on the outside? Takeaway/theme: Condensation can form from moisture in air on a sufficiently cool surface.
description: A diner wants to identify water appearing outside a cold glass, but blames a nonexistent crack. A split view traces moisture from nearby air onto the cooled outer surface.
